decision.explanation: The source documents present conflicting assertions regarding the architectural style of the San Vicente Ferrer Church. Document 1 (D1S1) and Document 2 (D2S2) explicitly describe the church as 'Baroque'. Conversely, Document 3 (D3S3 and D3S7) lists the style as 'Modernist' and describes the church as having a 'unique Modernist design'. Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and treat all audits as fallible, both 'Baroque' and 'Modernist' are retained as valid answers derived directly from the provided text.
